title: TDS 2026 — official course JSON and GPX
claims: The official TDS 2026 course data contains 24 timing points and a measured trace of 150,772 m.
The official trace totals +9,322 m and −9,509 m, with minimum and maximum elevations of 721 m and 2,589 m.
The official trace starts at 1,222 m in Courmayeur and finishes at 1,035 m in Chamonix.

The official timing points include 12 cut-offs: Lac Combal, Petit Saint-Bernard, Bourg-Saint-Maurice, Fort de la Platte, Cormet de Roselend, La Gittaz, Beaufort, Hauteluce, Le Signal, Les Contamines, Bellevue and Les Houches, plus the finish.

The official timing data marks bag drop at Courmayeur, Beaufort and Chamonix, rest areas at Beaufort, Les Contamines, Chalets du Truc and Chamonix, and runner assistance at Courmayeur, Bourg-Saint-Maurice, Beaufort, Les Contamines, Chalets du Truc and Chamonix.
